FlowerPainter.Feature.shore.Tooltip: Switches itself on when the area is partly in water or runs along it: piers, a filled quay, a promenade or a natural edge along the waterline. Away from water it does nothing.
FlowerPainter.Shore.Issue.TooWet: Almost all of the area is water, so there is no dry ground left for the shore.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.Name: Shore
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.style.Tooltip: How the waterline is built. Automatic turns the middle into a quay with a pier and the rest into a promenade.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.bandWidth.Tool: How deep the shore strip on land is (promenade, quay apron, sand).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.connect.Toolti: Joins the waterside walk to the nearest paths of the park or square.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.piers.Tooltip: Piers reaching out over the water. They need water inside the area.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.pierHeads.Tool: A cross deck at the end of each pier, with benches looking out.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.wharfDepth.Too: How far the quay is built out into the water. The water is filled in permanently.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.wharfShare.Too: How much of the shoreline becomes quay.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.boats.Tooltip: Boats moored at the quay and the piers, or pulled up on a beach.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.cargo.Tooltip: Small groups of crates, barrels and nets on the quay.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.reedDensity.To: Clumps of reeds along the waterline and in the shallows.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.Issue.NoWater: Shore: no water in or next to this area, so nothing was built.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.Issue.WharfNee: Shore: a quay is built out into water inside the area. Draw the area over the water to get one; a quay edge was made instead.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Shore.Issue.PiersNee: Shore: piers need water inside the area. Draw the area over the water.
FlowerPainter.Pond.islands.Tooltip: Islands in the open water, raised above it and planted. Fewer fit in a small pond.
FlowerPainter.Pond.bridges.Tooltip: Arched footbridges from each island to the shore and between close islands.
FlowerPainter.Pond.jets.Tooltip: Fountain jets in the open water.
FlowerPainter.Pond.boathouse.Tooltip: A boathouse at the water's edge with a jetty and rowing boats.
FlowerPainter.Pond.rowboats.Tooltip: Extra rowing boats out on the water.
FlowerPainter.Pond.promenade.Tooltip: A paved walk all round the water with benches and lamps.
FlowerPainter.Pond.connect.Tooltip: Joins the promenade, bridges and boathouse to the park's paths.
FlowerPainter.Pond.Issue.NoPromenade: Pond: too small for a promenade round it.
FlowerPainter.Pond.Issue.NoBoathouse: Pond: no free bank for the boathouse.
